UserProgressDoc.title: UserProgressDoc
UserProgressDoc.description: Stores an authenticated learner's profile metadata and full synchronized Lithuanian declension learning progress.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

providerId.description: Primary authentication provider identifier (google.com, apple.com, password).

progressJson.description: Serialized UserProgress JSON state including wordStats, caseStats, declensionStats, topicStats, dailyActivity, favorites, unlockedBadges, and recentMistakes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cloud profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the cloud progress was last synchronized.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user document storing learning progress, statistics, settings, and profile metadata.
